topic: Ideation, User Journey Mapping, and Solution Exploration
learningObjectives: Generate multiple solution ideas from a defined user problem.
Map user emotions, actions, and pain points across a journey.
Select concepts for further exploration using clear criteria.

activities.title: User Journey Map
activities.instruction: Explore the user's journey from start to finish.

content.concept: A journey map visualizes user stages, actions, thoughts, emotions, pain points, and opportunities across an experience.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Journey Sequencer
activities.instruction: Arrange the user's actions in the correct order.

content.concept: Mapping actions in sequence helps reveal friction points and opportunities throughout the complete user experience.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Ideation Builder
activities.instruction: Combine solution concepts to address the user problem.

content.concept: Ideation expands the solution space by generating multiple possibilities before narrowing toward promising concepts.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Concept Selection Lab
activities.instruction: Select concepts using the given design criteria.

content.concept: Early concepts can be compared using factors such as user value, feasibility, clarity, and alignment with the problem.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
